content: supabase.auth.admin.deleteUser(id, shouldSoftDelete=false) hard-deletes the auth.users row and cascades only to auth.* internal tables (sessions, refresh tokens). It does NOT cascade to public schema tables unless those tables declare 'on delete cascade' FKs to auth.users. Critically, deleting a user who still owns storage.objects rows FAILS with FK violation 'objects_owner_fkey' (github.com/supabase/storage#65) — storage objects for that user must be deleted BEFORE calling admin.deleteUser().
